parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to view the details of all clusters under your account, such as the cluster ID. The cluster must be in the Running state before you call this operation. You can verify the state by checking the DBClusterStatus parameter returned by DescribeDBClusterAttribute
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息（如集群ID）。 调用前集群必须处于 Running 状态；可通过 DescribeDBClusterAttribute 返回的 DBClusterStatus 确认
